slides.h:
5 Excel mistakes
that quietly break
your totals.

slides.b: Green triangle in the corner? SUM skips that cell. Select the column and Convert to Number.
=B2*16% breaks when the rate changes. Put 16% in its own cell and point to it.
SUM adds the rows you filtered out. =SUBTOTAL(109, B2:B500) adds only what you can see.
"Nairobi " isn't "Nairobi", so lookups miss. =TRIM(A2) cleans them out.
They break sorting and filters. Use Center Across Selection instead: same look, nothing breaks.

Tell Toso what the sheet is for. Get it finished in Excel, formulas checked.
